# Callouts {#sec-g-callouts}

Each callout type has one house meaning. A reader who learns the meaning once can skim a book by its callouts. Every example below shows the rendered callout, then its source, then when the house style uses it.

## In plain terms {#sec-g-callouts-plain}

::: {.callout-tip}
## In plain terms
The treated samples had more of a small set of features than the control samples.
:::

````markdown
::: {.callout-tip}
## In plain terms
The treated samples had more of a small set of features than the control samples.
:::
````

Use it for the lay summary at the top of every chapter.

## Status {#sec-g-callouts-status}

::: {.callout-note}
## Status
Last run on the synthetic example data, 2026-01-15.
:::

````markdown
::: {.callout-note}
## Status
Last run on the synthetic example data, 2026-01-15.
:::
````

Use it for what data a chapter last ran on, and when.

## How to read this {#sec-g-callouts-read}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## How to read this
Each row is one feature. A pale cell is a small difference from that feature's own mean, not low expression.
:::

````markdown
::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## How to read this
Each row is one feature. A pale cell is a small difference from that feature's own mean, not low expression.
:::
````

Use it before any figure a reader could misread, especially a heatmap.

## A caveat to read first {#sec-g-callouts-caveat}

::: {.callout-important}
## Which number this chapter uses
This chapter counts features that pass both thresholds. The FDR threshold alone gives a larger number. The two are not interchangeable.
:::

````markdown
::: {.callout-important}
## Which number this chapter uses
This chapter counts features that pass both thresholds. The FDR threshold alone gives a larger number. The two are not interchangeable.
:::
````

Use it for a caveat that must be read before the numbers.

## A count of zero {#sec-g-callouts-zero}

::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple"}
## A count of zero is not a measured absence
A zero means no feature passed at this design's detection floor. It is a failure to detect, not a measurement of nothing.
:::

````markdown
::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple"}
## A count of zero is not a measured absence
A zero means no feature passed at this design's detection floor. It is a failure to detect, not a measurement of nothing.
:::
````

Use it wherever a result can be empty.

## Missing provenance {#sec-g-callouts-manifest}

::: {.callout-caution}
## No run manifest
No run manifest was found. When the analysis ran, and whether it ran cleanly, are unknown.
:::

````markdown
::: {.callout-caution}
## No run manifest
No run manifest was found. When the analysis ran, and whether it ran cleanly, are unknown.
:::
````

Use it when provenance is missing.

## A gated section {#sec-g-callouts-na}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## Not applicable to this report
This section covers a second contrast. It did not run because the design has one contrast. Nothing was computed and nothing is hidden.
:::

````markdown
::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## Not applicable to this report
This section covers a second contrast. It did not run because the design has one contrast. Nothing was computed and nothing is hidden.
:::
````

Use it in place of a section that does not apply. In R, `not_applicable()` writes it for you.

## The interpretation banner {#sec-g-callouts-banner}

::: {.callout-important}
## This chapter is interpretation, not a result
It is the author's reading of the measurements. No number in it is new.
:::

````markdown
::: {.callout-important}
## This chapter is interpretation, not a result
It is the author's reading of the measurements. No number in it is new.
:::
````

Use it once, at the top of the synthesis chapter.

## A collapsed callout {#sec-g-callouts-collapsed}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Details of the filter
Features with a mean count below the threshold were removed before testing.
:::

````markdown
::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Details of the filter
Features with a mean count below the threshold were removed before testing.
:::
````

Use it for detail most readers can skip.

## Summary {#sec-g-callouts-summary}

| Callout type | Title pattern | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| tip | In plain terms | Lay summary at the top of a chapter |
| note | Status | What data the chapter ran on, and when |
| note, simple | How to read this | Read before a non-obvious figure |
| important | A caveat, for example "Which number this chapter uses" | Read before the numbers |
| warning, simple | A count of zero is not a measured absence | Wherever a result can be empty |
| caution | No run manifest | Provenance is missing |
| note, simple | Not applicable to this report | A gated section that did not run |
| important | This chapter is interpretation, not a result | Banner on the synthesis chapter |
| note, collapsed | Any short title | Detail most readers can skip |

: Callout types and their house meaning. {#tbl-g-callouts-summary}
